versions.changelog:
- Initial release of alibabacloud-oss-cross-account-auth-diagnosis.
- Diagnoses OSS cross-account authorization failures including AccessDenied/NoPermission, trust-policy gaps, RAM policy scope issues, and AssumeRole failures.
- Provides evidence-based attribution and emits ready-to-apply authorization templates; does not make any changes.
- Strictly read-only: never applies, writes, or suggests commands to modify authorization.
- All diagnostics executed via provided scripts, not via ad-hoc OSS/SDK/CLI calls.
- Scope limited to cross-account authorization; use other dedicated skills for transfer, endpoint, CRR, ossfs, direct-link, signed-URL, and same-account RAM authorization errors.
